2025年度国家科学技术奖揭晓，2个量子科技项目斩获一等奖
7月8日，2025年度国家科学技术奖揭晓，中国科学院物理研究所陈立泉院士和中国电子科技集团贲德院士，荣获国家最高科学技术奖。并评选出258个项目和11名科技专家。其中，量子领域共有2个项目获奖。具体包括：由北京大学王恩哥、江颖、李新征、徐莉梅、高毅勤团队完成的水的氢键强度及动力学过程全量子效应研究荣获国家自然科学奖一等奖；由同济大学物理科学与工程学院程鑫彬教授领衔完成的项目“量子化光晶格常数的纳米计量关键技术及集成电路应用”荣获国家科学技术进步奖一等奖。

Google Quantum AI等实现量子纠错的强化学习控制
本研究开创了量子纠错（
QEC）的新范式，成功将纠错与系统校准合二为一。传统方法需中断计算进行重校准，与长时算法不兼容，该工作利用强化学习代理，将QEC过程中产生的错误检测事件同时用作学习信号，在计算进行中持续引导控制参数，实时稳定量子系统。研究人员在
Willow超导处理器上实验验证，使表面码对漂移的稳定性提升3.5倍，并创下表面码（每周期逻辑误差7.72(9)×10⁻⁴）与颜色码（8.19(14)×10⁻³）的性能纪录。数值仿真表明，该框架可扩展至数万控制参数的大型码，且优化速度与系统规模无关。这一成果标志着“会学习的量子计算机”成为现实，实现了永不中断的持续量子计算。研究成果于7月8日发表于《Nature》（自然）。

## 2025 National Science and Technology Awards Announced: Two Quantum Technology Projects Win First Prize

On July 8, China's 2025 National Science and Technology Awards were announced. Academician Chen Liquan of the Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Academician Ben De of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC) received the National Supreme Science and Technology Award. ## Google Quantum AI and Collaborators Achieve Reinforcement-Learning Control for Quantum Error Correction

This work establishes a new paradigm for quantum error correction (QEC) by unifying error correction with system calibration. Conventional approaches require halting computation for recalibration—incompatible with long-running algorithms. The researchers employed a reinforcement-learning agent that simultaneously uses the error-detection events generated during the QEC process as learning signals, continuously steering control parameters while computation proceeds to stabilize the quantum system in real time. Experimental validation on the Willow superconducting processor demonstrated a 3.5× improvement in surface code stability against drift and set performance records for both the surface code (logical error rate per cycle: 7.72(9) × 10⁻⁴) and the color code (8.19(14) × 10⁻³). Numerical simulations indicate that the framework scales to large codes with tens of thousands of control parameters, with optimization speed independent of system size. This result marks the realization of a "self-learning quantum computer," enabling uninterrupted, continuous quantum computation. Published in *Nature* on July 8.

On July 7, the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) launched Project Triad, aimed at integrating quantum sensing, quantum networking, and quantum computing into a single operational ecosystem to accelerate real-world applications and commercialization. Project Triad will be supported by three programs—the NSF National Quantum Virtual Laboratory, NSF X-Labs, and NSF Quantum+X—bringing together government, academia, and industry to develop, test, and scale integrated quantum technologies. ## Palacký University (Czech Republic) et al. Reveal Covariant Formulation of the Berry Connection in Non-Hermitian Systems
